item.title: Uso no Idol Audition o Uke ni Kita Onna no Ko-tachi ni Doko made Yareru ka
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fiction7
  • 発売日: 2015-11-27
  • スコア: 6.05/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 嘘のアイドルオーディションを受けにきた女の子たちにどこまでやれるか
  • 英語名: Uso no Idol Audition o Uke ni Kita Onna no Ko-tachi ni Doko made Yareru ka

あらすじ

Honestly, you really come up with some things, don’t you? Holding a fake idol audition that doesn’t even exist? And then posting it online? I can’t believe it.

Knowing you, you weren’t planning on running a proper audition, were you? You were probably thinking about asking the girls sexual harassment questions and grinning, or maybe even trying to get handsy if you could.
